products.product_description: Red Button Vintage Creamery French Silk Pie, Net Wt. 31.88 oz. (904g), in a clear plastic dome and black plastic base, UPC 0 41172 81290 9, Distributed By: Associated Food Stores, Salt Lake City, Utah 84119 RMYA0421" printed on sleeve. Keep refrigerated.
products.code_info: Manufacturing Lot Code is an inkjet printed number on the clear dome. Affected pies will have lot code beginning with "2 266". Cases are labeled with MFG Date 9-23-22, Best By 9-23-23 . Expiration will also be assigned by individual retail stores. Lot numbers will be inkjet printed on the clear dome and begin with 2 266 , then hours and minutes, followed by AM or PM . EXAMPLE: 2 266 07:15 PM .
products.reason_for_recall: Pies labeled as Red Button French Silk may contain Turtle Cream Pies containing almonds which are not declared on the French Silk label.
